lower_description: Calm fresh pond water for a cozy pixel art farming RPG, muted blue teal, flat high top-down orthogonal ground, sparse short pale blue ripple strokes, simple compact pixel clusters, low contrast interior, no ocean waves, no rocks or objects, no outlines around individual tiles.
upper_description: Soft green grassy pond bank matching farming lawn base #43894f. Grass ground with sparse small leaf strokes, irregular rounded natural grassy shoreline, narrow dark teal submerged edge and subtle lighter shallow water at the shore. Flat bank, no cliff, no stone retaining wall, no square pool coping. Cozy hand-pixelled 16-bit farming game style. No flowers, buildings or objects, no realistic texture, no blur, no dithering.
